title: Benchmark NPU inference latency and FPS
prompt:
The board is already reachable over SSH (MOSS_DEVICE_*). Do not guess a host and do not ask for one.

Benchmark the NPU with the board's shipped test model:
`hrt_model_exec perf --model_file /app/multimedia_samples/chip_base_test/01_cpu_bpu_ddr/models/HBDK3_MODEL_2K/x5/gen_I2004_ForTest2k_1x1088x2048x3.hbm --thread_num 2`

It prints `Average latency is: X ms` and `Frame rate is: Y FPS` after 200 frames.
Record TWO evidence rows with record_evidence (include task_id): metric `bpu_avg_latency_ms` with observed = the X value, and metric `bpu_fps` with observed = the Y value. Expected: latency under 100 ms and FPS above 10.

Do not reboot, reflash, or change any board configuration.

NOTE: the acceptance command is executed by the bench harness AFTER your turn, with its own environment (device credentials included). Do NOT try to run it yourself, read the repo .env, or investigate how the harness injects environment — that path is blocked by design. Do the device work, verify the outcome with your own probe, record evidence, and finish.
